name: Liberia
description: Liberia from its founding by freed American slaves in 1822 to Africa's first republic, the Americo-Liberian elite, two civil wars and Ellen Johnson Sirleaf.

checkpoints.name: The settlers
checkpoints.note: Freed black Americans landed in 1822 and founded Monrovia.

checkpoints.name: The old republic
checkpoints.note: Liberia became independent in 1847. The settlers' descendants ruled the native peoples, and Firestone ran the rubber.

checkpoints.name: Coups and wars
checkpoints.note: Doe seized power in 1980. Two civil wars from 1989 to 2003 killed some 250,000 people.

checkpoints.name: Peace
checkpoints.note: Peace came in 2003. Ellen Johnson Sirleaf was elected in 2005, and Ebola struck in 2014.

audio.title: All Hail, Liberia, Hail!
